title: OhSit
description: OhSit is a client-side sitting animation mod that lets you sit on the ground with 6 different poses.
body:
## Feature
- 6 Sitting Poses — Sit, Relaxed, Curl, Knees, Side Sit, Cross-legged
- Radial Menu — Press M to open a sleek wheel selector and pick a pose instantly
- AFK Auto-Sit — Stand still for too long and your character will automatically sit down in a random pose. 
- Multiplayer Synced — Other players can see your sitting animation. No server-side mod required for manual sitting (auto-sit feature requires the mod on the server)
- EMF Compatible — Automatically pauses Entity Model Features animations while sitting

## Requirements
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- [playeranimator](https://modrinth.com/mod/playeranimator) (KosmX)
